critic_evaluation.feedback: The no-change proposal is plausible based on the visible calendar: Wednesday already has an Industry Networking Dinner from 20:00-23:30, and there is no visible Wednesday Live Stream to cancel. The resulting calendar is conflict-free and internally consistent, but the routine as a whole is quite full across the visible week, with repeated long production days and late evening commitments. Since those pressures are pre-existing and not introduced by the proposal, they do not by themselves justify blaming the no-op.
